score_notes.christology: Orthodox Trinitarian, Nicene Christology. CREC affirms historic creeds.
score_notes.scripture: High view of Scripture — Reformed, confessional, affirms inerrancy in the classical Reformed sense.
score_notes.gender: CREC is explicitly patriarchal — Doug Wilson's network has led the Reformed critique of 'soft complementarianism.' Male-only elders and pastors. Household-centered, anti-feminist.
score_notes.leadership: Plurality of male pastors/elders (Horvath + Gilanyi, installed 2023). CREC polity with denominational accountability.
score_notes.soteriology: Federal Vision stance not stated on homepage; yellow holds — verify via statement-of-faith page or by sermon/elder statements.
score_notes.cultural: Counter-cultural, postmillennial, classical Christian education emphasis. No DEI/CRT language. | GREEN signal: Pastor Rev. Kasey Horvath is a public signatory of "The Statement on Social Justice and the Gospel" (the 2018 "Dallas Statement," statementonsocialjustice.com), the post-2018 Big Eva line in the sand against CRT, woke evangelicalism, and feminized social justice. Verified via Wayback Machine snapshots. Per the "people is policy" principle, this is a strong positive marker of orthodox conservative-Reformed conviction.
score_notes.preaching: Covenant renewal worship, expository preaching, liturgical. Strong continuity with Christ Church Moscow model.
score_notes.mission: Born as a church plant (1999), continues CREC church-planting and Kingdom-building ethos.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Not mentioned on homepage; yellow holds.
score_notes.denominational: CREC affiliation re-verified on site: 'All Saints Church is a Reformed congregation in covenant with the Communion of Reformed Evangelical Churches (CREC).' — green holds.

churches.assessment: All Saints Church in New Holland, PA (Lancaster County) was established in 1999 as a church plant of Christ Church (Moscow, ID) and is a member of the CREC. Dr. Gregg Strawbridge served faithfully as pastor for twenty years (2002–2022) and is the founder of the Strawbridge Ministerial Forum hosted by the church. Following his passing in 2022, Rev. Kasey Horvath (lead) and Rev. Brandon Gilanyi (associate) were installed in 2023, and the congregation relocated to a historic building in New Holland in 2024. Theologically this is a classic Moscow-network CREC congregation: Reformed, covenant-renewal liturgical worship, paedocommunion, classical Christian education ethos, patriarchal household vision, and postmillennial cultural engagement. The one area calling for direct inquiry is soteriology — CREC churches have historically been associated with Federal Vision theology, which modifies traditional Reformed articulations of justification. Ask the elders directly about their position on FV and justification. For a Reformed man in Lancaster County seeking a serious, liturgical, Moscow-aligned CREC home, this is the obvious first visit.
churches.gender_detail: Patriarchal household vision, male headship, anti-feminist. Male-only pastors/elders (Horvath, Gilanyi).
churches.denomination_detail: Communion of Reformed Evangelical Churches (CREC)

churches.name: Christ Church
churches.overall_label: GREEN — Confessional CREC congregation; plural male eldership, covenant-renewal worship, classical Christian education, and a robustly counter-secular Reformed posture under Pastor Duane Garner.

score_notes.christology: Green — Trinitarian and orthodox; the church’s whole life is ordered around “the community of the Trinity… realized in the community of the Church,” and it confesses no hope for sinners “apart from the saving mercy and the work of the Lord Jesus Christ.”
score_notes.scripture: Green — Holds the Bible as “absolutely authoritative… the ultimate authority of our thinking,” and subscribes to the historic Reformed confessions and catechisms (Westminster standards within the CREC).
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Green — Strong covenant-household and classical-education ethos typical of CREC congregations; a large board of male deacons and an emphasis on raising and discipling households.
score_notes.soteriology: Green — Reformed and monergistic: “All men are sinners, justly deserving God’s wrath and without hope apart from… the Lord Jesus Christ.” Salvation by grace through faith within the covenant.
score_notes.gender: Green — Patriarchal/complementarian by conviction; governed by a plurality of male elders (Session) and male deacons only, with no women in office; family-integrated, covenant-renewal worship.
score_notes.leadership: Green — Elder-led Session (Pastor Duane Garner, Associate Pastor Peter Jones, plus ruling elders John Mitchell, Scott Moonen, Nathaniel Talbott) with a full board of deacons — plural male eldership.
score_notes.preaching: Green — Reformed, text-driven preaching set within covenant-renewal (liturgical) worship, with heavy Scripture reading and Psalm-singing.
score_notes.mission: Green — Great Commission pursued through covenant faithfulness, household discipleship, and Christian education, with an optimistic (postmillennial) eschatology.
score_notes.cultural: Green — Explicitly counter-secular and confessional; a “mere Christendom” / biblical-theocracy posture that is the opposite of DEI/CRT or social-justice drift.
score_notes.denominational: Green — Member of the CREC (Communion of Reformed Evangelical Churches); Pastor Duane Garner serves as Presiding Minister of the CREC’s Augustine Presbytery — strong external accountability plus elder plurality.

churches.denomination_detail: CREC — Augustine Presbytery. Confessional, covenantal, paedobaptist Reformed; covenant-renewal (liturgical) worship, Psalm-singing, classical Christian education.
churches.pastor_credentials: Bachelor of Bible Languages, Oxford Baptist Institute (Oxford, MS); four years at the Bucer Institute for Biblical Studies; ACBC-certified biblical counselor; Presiding Minister of the CREC’s Augustine Presbytery. Associate Pastor: Peter Jones (M.A. Theology, Reformed Presbyterian Theological Seminary).
churches.assessment: Christ Church is a CREC (Communion of Reformed Evangelical Churches) congregation meeting in Morrisville, North Carolina, led by Pastor Duane Garner — an ACBC-certified biblical counselor who also serves as Presiding Minister of the CREC’s Augustine Presbytery. It is confessional and covenantal: the Bible is “absolutely authoritative,” the historic Reformed confessions and catechisms are its doctrinal summary, worship follows the covenant-renewal pattern with Psalm-singing, and the congregation is governed by a plurality of male elders and deacons. Its culture is family-integrated, classically educated, and robustly counter-secular. An acquaintance of MOOP recommended it as “super solid” — free of the wokeness, CRT, and female-leadership concerns this directory screens for. It earns green across all ten categories.
churches.enrichment_notes: [2026-06-17] Deep-dive enrichment from christchurchnc.com/christkirknc.com (about + leadership): CREC denomination corrected (was mislabeled “Conservative Reformed Episcopal Conference” — CREC = Communion of Reformed Evangelical Churches). Full 10-category scorecard substantiated; logo + Facebook added; rated GREEN. Listed at a member’s recommendation (“super solid, none of the wokeness / CRT / female leaders”).
